findings.title: G7 formal preflight accepted public source-task lineage mutation
findings.evidence: The pre-repair source-task mutation preserved all structural identity checks after recomputing the label hash and was accepted by strict preflight.
findings.remediation: Freeze and enforce canonical SHA-256 identities for the exact public cases, private labels, and corrected retry plan; add an adversarial source-task mutation test.

resolutions.evidence: Strict preflight now computes and compares canonical hashes for public, labels, and plan rows. The source-task mutation test passes; focused G7 tests pass 57/57; the full suite passes 247/247; immutable preflight reports all three expected hashes with no mismatch.
resolutions.reason: Local frozen-input lineage defect fixed; provider, provenance, mathematical, statistical, and scientific-release gates remain external or blocked.
